description: Retain the two lowest-yield AUs and keep harvesting the two marginal AUs with material volume.
rationale: CWH_CW_L and CWH_YC_L are the two AUs where managed TIPSY is far below VDYP and the long-run volume contribution is negligible. Retaining all four AUs would remove 32.0% of model THLB and reduce the 100-year average managed harvest to about 79% of the pro-rated AAC. Retaining only these two removes 6.0% of THLB while preserving about 98.4% of the pro-rated AAC. CWH_HW_L and CWH_CW_M remain harvestable because they carry most of the volume among the four problem AUs.
